title: Filter Replacement Light
fullDescription: Filter timer expired (~6-8 months). Replace and reset.

title: Fan Motor Error
fullDescription: Fan motor not turning. Plastic wrap on filter most common cause.

fixSteps.title: Clean port
fixSteps.instruction: Open sensor cover (side), use canned air.

title: Won't Power On
fullDescription: No response when pressing power. Check filter cover safety switch.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cover
fixSteps.instruction: Twist filter cover until firm click.

title: Plastic Burning Odor
fullDescription: New unit emitting plastic odor — usually filter wrap or new motor break-in.

title: Whistle or Rattle
fullDescription: Vibration on high speed. Filter may be incorrectly seated.

fixSteps.title: Reseat filter
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and reinstall to ensure flat seat.

title: VeSync Pairing Failed
fullDescription: Pairing process times out. Often 5GHz issue.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold WiFi button 5 sec to reset network.

title: AQI Stuck High
fullDescription: Sensor reads bad air permanently. Clean sensor port.

fixSteps.title: Clean
fixSteps.instruction: Vacuum sensor inlet on side panel.

title: Display Off in Auto
fullDescription: Sleep mode or display lock active. By design at night, but user can disable.

fixSteps.title: Press display
fixSteps.instruction: Tap display icon to toggle brightness.

title: Reduced Output
fullDescription: Filter clogged or pre-filter dirty restricting airflow.

fixSteps.instruction: Run a normal cycle to verify.
